items.source:
ExecutableMapReduceOperation allows creation and execution of MongoDB mapReduce operations in a fluent API style. The starting domainType is used for mapping an optional Query provided via matching into the MongoDB specific representation. By default, the originating domainType is also used for mapping back the results from the Document. However, it is possible to define an different returnType via as to mapping the result.
The collection to operate on is by default derived from the initial domainType and can be defined there via Document. Using inCollection allows to override the collection name for the execution. 
    
        mapReduce(Human.class)
            .map("function() { emit(this.id, this.firstname) }")
            .reduce("function(id, name) { return sum(id, name); }")
            .inCollection("star-wars")
            .as(Jedi.class)
            .matching(query(where("lastname").is("skywalker")))
            .all();
items.translation:
ExecutableMapReduceOperation 支持以流畅 API 风格创建并执行 MongoDB 的 mapReduce 操作。起始的 domainType 用于将可选的 Query（通过 matching 提供）映射为 MongoDB 特定的表示形式。默认情况下，初始 domainType 也用于将结果从 Document 映射回来。但是，可以通过 as 定义不同的 returnType 来映射结果。
要操作的集合默认源自初始 domainType，并可通过 Document 在此处定义。使用 inCollection 可以覆盖执行时的集合名称。 
    
        mapReduce(Human.class)
            .map("function() { emit(this.id, this.firstname) }")
            .reduce("function(id, name) { return sum(id, name); }")
            .inCollection("star-wars")
            .as(Jedi.class)
            .matching(query(where("lastname").is("skywalker")))
            .all();
自 4.0 版本起，推荐使用org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation。
